title: On June 17, the Fed makes a decision that moves every market

beats.narration: On June 17, the Federal Reserve makes a decision that moves every market on the planet.
At stake: whether to finally cut interest rates after holding them high for months.
Lower rates make borrowing cheaper — good for stocks, housing, and especially banks.
Banks like JPMorgan tend to earn more when lending picks back up.
But if the Fed waits, markets that already priced in a cut could pull back fast.
One meeting, trillions of dollars on the line. Follow for more.
